mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, IFNULL(r.payer_user_id, r.user_id) AS payerUserId, SUM(ABS(r.amount)) AS totalAmount FROM tb_record_detail r WHERE r.record_book_id = #{recordBookId} AND date_format(r.occur_time, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND r.audit_status = 2 AND r.amount < 0 AND r.delete_time IS NULL GROUP BY r.user_id, IFNULL(r.payer_user_id, r.user_id)
